Hyper adds Hyp3rc0d3 workflow mode and updates the Pi SDK to 1.5.0. The mode keeps your selected model and reasoning effort, retains workflow results across restarts, and uses a recursive finalization check to collect child-agent work before the final report. Completion notifications no longer trigger repeated reports during an active turn.

Saved sessions with large image or tool records are discoverable again. `/reload` now calls the Pi SDK to refresh skills, templates and extensions without replacing the conversation. OpenAI sign-in supplies a persistent installation ID and handles cancellation without leaving the session stuck.

Settings now separates AI settings from Saved agents. Large model catalogs and recursive agent finalization avoid repeated work. Tool links, provider dialogs and skin styling also receive fixes.

New network prompts return a not-started storage error while a lifecycle checkpoint is pending, instead of waiting and potentially being attempted later. Already accepted results and aborts remain available.
